params.name: intensity
params.description: Brightness added by one pixel (of 1), as FFmpeg's `intensity`; 250 pixels in a cell reach white

params.name: samples
params.description: The plot is taken from a grid of samples x samples input pixels (bounded cost; 128 gives 16384 samples per cell)

params.name: color_mode
params.description: Tint the plot with the chroma color of its position (false: white)

params.name: graticule
params.description: Draw a crosshair and a circle

params.name: opacity
params.description: Blend over the input picture: 1 = only the generated picture, 0 = the input unchanged
